subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing TUI multiline keys, or should OpenClaw expose a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current source already supports Shift+Enter newline through `pi-tui`, but the remaining configurable behavior would add new user-facing configuration surface that repository policy treats as high-bar product/API work.

options.title: Document current keys first
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings to a separate explicit product decision.

options.title: Add TUI keybinding config
options.body: Expose a narrow config or CLI bridge into `pi-tui` keybindings with tests for default Enter-to-send and the alternate send/newline mode.

options.title: Close as already implemented
options.body: Treat dependency-backed Shift+Enter support as enough and leave configurable shortcuts to adjacent composer/keybinding requests.

recommendation.title: Document current keys first
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings to a separate explicit product decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already supplied the prior maintainer-facing scope analysis on this issue and has central TUI wrapper history.
